headline: United States bombs Iranian island
summary: The United States bombed Qeshm, an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz. The strike followed three Iranian attacks on Bahrain within five days.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil transit chokepoints, so military escalation there directly affects crude supply risk and prices.
why_moved: The input reports a US strike on an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz following Iranian attacks on Bahrain, a Gulf state, raising geopolitical risk in a key oil shipping route.
